note: Re-judged 2026-11-15 after 22be149a08 changed runSession: its last statement now hands a non-nil end error to reportSessionEnd (problems.go), which logs INFO for a session ze stopped and otherwise raises doctor-ldp-session-ended and logs WARN; a nil issue queue (tests) yields ErrNotStarted, never a panic. It runs after Start returns, so the KeepAlive sender goroutine (waits on accepted, re-reads currentKeepalive()/3 each cycle, re-arms on KeepaliveChanged, SendKeepalive on each tick), the accepting KeepAlive in the on-init callback, the defer order and handleInit are unchanged, and both tagged units are byte-identical (the sessionparams file changed only in the helloTransportAddr helper, which the negative does not call). RFC 5036 Section 3.5.4.1: "An LSR MUST arrange that its peer receive an LDP message from it at least every KeepAlive Time period." Positive: runSession to operational with both sides at 1s and an empty LIB; each of the next three PDUs must be a KeepAlive and each gap at most 1s; the peer feeds ze's 1s KeepAlive Timer, which removes no assertion. Negative (dual-tagged with RFC5036-3.5.4.1-1): TestRFC5036KeepalivePacingFollowsNegotiatedTime has ze propose 60s and the peer 1s, then requires each of the next three PDUs within 1s of the previous; type is unchecked, which the row allows (any LDP message will do), and a sender pacing from the 60s proposal fails it. Row-quality: the first sentence duplicates RFC5036-3.5.4.1-1 verbatim.
